banner: HISTORICAL, PRE-FIX INVENTORY. Prepared 2026-10-28 (about 04:50 UTC) by the read-only inventory agent at HEAD 23a68f6, BEFORE the fix rounds (commits 7ba0435 and 8a1a59e) and before the post-fix real run. Its run-level figures describe stale pre-fix runs (code 782668c, tree 810e3288) and are NOT results; they are superseded by the post-fix run of 2026-10-28 (code 8a1a59e) reported in results.json. Kept for the record: cohort identities, dry-run overlap (section 7), anomalies and decisions taken.

anomalies: Stranded job 6481f266 (build_feature_set, status running, lease expired 04:40:56 UTC, owner process gone) and feature set 0ad3a2dd left 'building' at 30/60. Any worker started on the shared DB will reclaim and resume it with whatever code is checked out at that moment.

A preview API process (uvicorn pid 99436, config 'dermpath-api-shared', started 23:58 local) holds the shared DB open read-write and runs the pre-fix code in memory; UI actions write to the real DB. No job handler was found in dermpath/main.py, so jobs it enqueues would stay queued.

Dry-run overlap with the real test split: the same 6 patients were used by every 6-slide dry run; 4 of them are in the real test split (4 of 15 test patients, 4 slides). 2 were dry-run test patients scored by dry-run test releases (up to 4 times, tiny 4-slide models); 2 were dry-run training patients (labels read, slides used for dry-run Macenko references). This happened before the real split was frozen. No real-cohort run, threshold or candidate used them: 0 test releases, 0 sealed patients, 0 test predictions in the shared DB.

Two undecided near-duplicate candidate pairs (dHash 5 and 6, different patients, same label) lie inside the development pool, and each pair was split across CV folds in s3 (folds 0/4 and 3/0). If either is a true duplicate, OOF estimates leak across folds. near_duplicate_review has 0 rows.

ABMIL fitting: docs/config text says the final model is refitted on the development pool, the code fits 34/45 bags with an 11-bag inner hold-out (the design's Implemented-differently note at §6 says there is no refit).
Calibration evidence counts bags (45), not patients (35) or duplicate groups.

s0/s1 came from a separate '--only s0,s1' invocation 15 s before the full run, which then skipped them because the files existed (the brief's item-4 defect). Here the code tree (810e3288) and driver (2e15ff00) were identical, so the skip was harmless; it was not checked by the driver.
docs/readiness.md is dated 2026-10-26 (173 tests; real cohorts 'not measured') and docs/ml-engine-report.md does not exist although ml-engine-design.md line 7 refers to it.
All 17 real-cohort runs use training seed 0; the brief asks for multiple predeclared seeds.

Observation (cause not verified): 19 comparison_family_member rows but only 2 comparison_family.member_added audit events in the COBRA project; members created together with their runs may be audited only via experiment.created.

environment.midnight_adapter_parity_record: scratchpad/midnight_parity_result.json (2026-10-26): adapter vs transformers Dinov2Model.from_pretrained, 8 CC0 patches, cpu fp32, max_abs_diff 2.0e-6, cos_min 0.99999994; mps vs cpu cos_min 0.99999994. Not a comparison with kaiko's own pipeline; the official transform (Resize 224, CenterCrop 224, mean/std 0.5) is the identity on 224 px inputs apart from normalisation.

lead_decisions: Stranded build: do not start a worker on the shared DB until the fixes land; then either resume feature set 0ad3a2dd (about 26 min MPS, 30 intact artifacts reused) through the fixed driver, or cancel job 6481f266 and record why. The driver fix must handle a 'building' set whose job lease expired.
Stop the preview API (pid 99436) during the rerun, or accept that it serves pre-fix code on the real DB.

Ask the feature_sets.py / inference.py owners to keep the stain=none artifact cache-key inputs unchanged (extractor_version dermpath.feature_sets/2, preprocessing_version strings, policy/stain/env sha, mask and exclusion sha) or to declare a bump explicitly; otherwise about 62 min of extraction (S2 sets) plus 26 min (uniform Midnight) is lost. Verify with the s3 reuse probe (expect 60 cache hits, 0 fresh) before training.

After the fixes: rerun s0, s3 (about 40 s of training per 16 runs; 3 seeds x 4 combinations is still minutes) and s4 on dataset version 1868803e; mark families 8e64b136 and 5c326ae6 superseded (do not delete); re-declare the test candidate from post-fix runs before any s6.
Keep the macenko dev_cv arm blocked on the real cohort (none exists yet).
Have a human decide the 2 near-duplicate candidate pairs before the final benchmark; if confirmed, regroup them (new dataset version) before computing CV estimates.

Decide how to disclose the dry-run overlap (4 of 15 test patients processed in dry runs, 2 scored by dry-run test releases) in the evidence package and in any future test-release justification. Suggested wording: 'not used for real-cohort model selection', instead of 'never touched'.
Sampling study budget: a 1024-patch arm is roughly 2.5-3 h of Midnight extraction for the 45 development slides (estimate). Decide whether it is affordable before predeclaring it.
